integrity: The original 2007 honeycomb double-coverage construction is credited; only new arbitrary-erasure motif valuations and stochastic consequences are asserted. Numerical tests corroborate rather than certify analytical statements.
scientific_limitations: The coverage radius must exactly equal the honeycomb edge length and finite-set area/perimeter formulas do not cover arbitrary radius or border effects.
The Bernoulli formulas describe almost-sure planar densities, not connectivity or topology of holes.
Earlier 2006 draft shown in one bibliographic source has an unverified exact earliest public date; dated 2007-11-15 publication record anchors this archive source.
Historical priority remains provisional; no independent audit was performed.
title: Exact motif area and quantized boundary laws for failed honeycomb disk coverings
